description: This Dart source file defines a MaterialTheme class, providing helper methods for Material color schemes and themes for a Flutter application. It includes multiple predefined color schemes (light, dark, high contrast, etc.) and theme configurations, along with related classes like ExtendedColor and ColorFamily.

classes.name: MaterialTheme
classes.description: A helper class to manage Material color schemes and themes, providing static methods for various predefined schemes and theme creation.

classes.name: ExtendedColor
classes.description: Represents an extended color with different variants tailored for light and dark themes.

classes.name: ColorFamily
classes.description: Defines a set of colors related to a seed color, including container variants for UI theming.

methods.name: lightScheme
methods.description: Returns a ColorScheme for light mode with specific color definitions.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Creates a ThemeData object based on the light scheme.

methods.name: lightMediumContrast
methods.description: Creates a ThemeData object with a medium contrast light scheme.

methods.name: lightHighContrast
methods.description: Creates a ThemeData object with a high-contrast light scheme.

methods.name: darkScheme
methods.description: Returns a ColorScheme for dark mode with specific color definitions.

methods.name: dark
methods.description: Creates a ThemeData object based on the dark scheme.

methods.name: darkMediumContrast
methods.description: Creates a ThemeData object with a medium contrast dark scheme.

methods.name: darkHighContrast
methods.description: Creates a ThemeData object with a high contrast dark scheme.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Constructs a ThemeData object based on a provided ColorScheme.
